artist: Bertha Lum (1869-1954) - American woodblock print artist
category_basis: Bertha Lum died in 1954, so her life+70 term expired in 2024 - all of her work is now unambiguously public domain regardless of publication date. These specific prints were also published 1904-1920, independently satisfying the pre-1929 fixed-term rule. Every file is digitized by the Library of Congress and tagged PD-old-70-expired / Public domain on Wikimedia Commons.
